Refund failures leave payments half-refunded.

When the card gateway rejects a refund (we saw `PaymentError: gateway timeout` in the
logs), `PaymentService.refund` correctly raises, but afterwards the payment record
already shows the refunded amount and status `refunded`, and the order is marked
`refunded` too, although no money moved. A retry then fails with "refund exceeds the
remaining captured amount".

The refund code runs inside a `UnitOfWork` (shop/repository/unit_of_work.py) which is
documented to put every repository back the way it was when anything inside raises.
It seems to undo only some kinds of change. Other services will start using
`UnitOfWork` soon, so please fix the transaction support itself rather than
special-casing refunds.
